## edit after import

This is the only database boundary for MAS Activity.

1. Bind the same Postgres credential used by the existing MAS workflows.
2. Bind Header Auth on the webhook.
3. Activate this workflow.
4. Set `CONTROL_PLANE_PROXY_URL=http://n8n:5678/webhook/mas-control-plane` in Activity.

Operations: schema, create_case, get_case, list_cases, update_case, append_event, list_events, snapshot, append_error, list_errors, record_execution, case_id_for_execution, list_agents, upsert_agent, artifact_put, artifact_get.

`snapshot` returns case + events in one SQL / one n8n execution (Activity live feed).
Successful production executions are not saved; errors still are.

Activity contains no database driver and no Postgres connection. HITL state, events and error traces use the same proxy.
